About Gelato
Gelato has created the world's largest global network for on-demand production of custom products, from t-shirts and mugs to books and wall art. We empower ecommerce entrepreneurs to share their creativity worldwide through local, sustainable production. By matching supply with demand, we reduce waste and carbon emissions.
We don't own production facilities; we build the software that connects them. With over 250 production operations in 30+ countries, our network can deliver custom products to five billion people in just 72 hours.
GelatoConnect is our B2B SaaS platform and operating system for print businesses, connecting quoting, order intake, procurement, production and shipping. By improving efficiency and reducing costs, we help businesses become more scalable, sustainable and profitable.
About the Role
GelatoConnect spans AI estimating, MIS, print on demand and a full operating system for print businesses. As we scale, we're sharpening our positioning, monetisation and go-to-market approach to accelerate adoption and recurring revenue growth.
We are seeking a commercially driven Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our GTM team. You'll take ownership of initiatives spanning positioning, go-to-market execution, sales enablement and customer advocacy, building the capabilities needed to support our growth.
As a commercial partner to Product leadership and a key counterpart to Sales, you'll translate complex technology into compelling customer value propositions, equip our teams to win business and represent the voice of the customer.
This is a highly hands-on role with significant ownership and visibility. We're looking for someone with deep B2B SaaS expertise, strong commercial instincts and the ability to shape direction while executing to deliver results.
What You Will Do
Working at the intersection of Product, Sales and GTM, your responsibilities will include:
Positioning & Narrative: Define value propositions, differentiation, Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) and personas. Translate complex technology into compelling narratives that communicate customer value and create demand.
Go-to-Market & Launches: Lead GTM initiatives for products, features and commercial opportunities, partnering with Product, Sales and Marketing to drive awareness, adoption and revenue.
Sales Enablement: Partner with Sales to understand customer challenges and buying journeys. Develop messaging, sales tools and enablement programmes that improve win rates and deal velocity.
Pricing & Packaging: Drive initiatives across the GelatoConnect portfolio, combining customer insights, competitive intelligence and product capabilities to develop commercial recommendations.
Portfolio Architecture: Define how AI Estimator, MIS, print on demand and GelatoConnect One fit together, including positioning, customer entry points, expansion opportunities and bundles.
Customer Value & Advocacy: Develop case studies, customer stories, testimonials and ROI-driven materials demonstrating business impact. Support adoption, cross-sell and upsell initiatives.
Win/Loss & Market Insights: Lead competitive intelligence and win/loss analysis, using customer research, sales insights and AI to inform Product Marketing priorities and commercial decisions.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Connect Product, Sales and Marketing, translating technical developments into commercial opportunities and ensuring teams have accurate product knowledge and messaging.

Who You Are
You are a commercially driven Product Marketing professional with deep B2B SaaS experience and a passion for translating complex technology into customer value. You combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution and understand how Product Marketing drives commercial outcomes.
You thrive in fast-moving environments, bringing structure, resourcefulness and momentum. You're confident challenging assumptions, influencing senior stakeholders and rolling up your sleeves to deliver results.
Requirements:
7+ years of Product Marketing experience within B2B SaaS, ideally in a high-growth or scale-up environment.
Proven experience positioning and launching complex software products, translating technical capabilities into customer value.
Strong track record partnering with Sales in complex, sales-assisted environments, with measurable impact on pipeline, win rates and revenue.
Experience executing GTM initiatives, sales enablement, and SaaS pricing and packaging.
Experience creating demand for emerging software solutions where customers may not yet recognise the need.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence influencing senior technical and commercial leaders.
Analytical and data-driven, with strong commercial judgement and a structured approach to execution.
Strong AI fluency, using AI tools to research, analyse, create and execute, and the ability to position AI-powered products to traditional industries.
Experience in vertical SaaS, operational software or workflow automation is a strong advantage.
International B2B SaaS go-to-market experience across multiple countries and languages is desirable.

What It's Like to Work at Gelato
We're a customer-obsessed team with the ambition to transform the printing industry through technology and more sustainable production. We have big goals and high expectations, and we value people who are passionate, entrepreneurial and motivated by our mission.
With 11 offices worldwide, we foster a collaborative and international culture. We encourage our teams to work from our offices at least three days per week to strengthen connections, collaboration and shared experiences.

To achieve our ambition, we are looking for colleagues who are ready to join us on this journey! Tomorrow can’t wait, let’s shape it together!
British American Tobacco Sweden has an exciting opportunity for an Operations Finance Controller in Malmö.
We're looking for a driven finance professional to join our Operations Finance team at BAT. You'll be at the centre of our month-end and budget cycles. You'll make sure our books are accurate, our numbers are explained, and our stakeholders have the insight they need to make decisions. If you like owning results, challenging the way things are done and working in a fast-moving FMCG environment, this role is for you.
 
Your key responsibilities will include:
Act as the Finance Business Partner for Manufacturing, QA, Logistics and other factory functions, providing financial insights and supporting operational decision-making.
Lead monthly performance reporting and analysis, translating P&L results, manufacturing costs and key business drivers into actionable recommendations for site leadership.
Coordinate budgeting, forecasting and planning processes, including OPEX, CAPEX, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow activities, while supporting the WOFF process and cost-saving initiatives.
Ensure effective management of fixed assets, intercompany recharges, cost allocations, master data and other core controlling activities to support accurate financial reporting.
Deliver timely and accurate month-end and year-end closing activities, including accruals, reconciliations, compliance controls and support for internal, external and tax audits.

 
What are we looking for?
Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field, together with a relevant professional finance qualification.
1-3 years of experience in Finance within FMCG, manufacturing or another fast-paced operational environment, with exposure to financial planning, analysis and business partnering.
Strong knowledge of financial systems and reporting tools, including advanced Excel skills; experience with SAP, BPC and BI tools is highly desirable.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills, with the ability to manage large volumes of information, prioritise effectively and deliver accurate results under tight deadlines.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence business partners, present financial insights clearly and communicate fluently in English.

 
What we offer you?

We are looking for a Product Manager/Product Owner to join our team in a hybrid working model in Goteborg and help our clients and internal teams transform business needs into well-defined technology and AI solutions while leading their delivery. You will work closely with stakeholders to understand how the business operates, shape requirements that teams can build and adopt and guide cross-functional teams through agile delivery. As a consultant, you will combine analytical rigor and structured delivery management with an advisory mindset, helping stakeholders prioritize, make informed decisions and realize measurable value.
You will take ownership of one or more products or workstreams, working with client stakeholders, architects, engineers and specialists. Assignments may vary in size, industry and delivery model, requiring flexibility to support diverse priorities across client engagements and internal initiatives.
Responsibilities
Work with business stakeholders and users to understand goals, current processes, pain points, and constraints, and translate them into clear problem statements, product scope, and measurable success criteria
Facilitate discovery activities such as interviews, workshops, and process walkthroughs, and map current and target business processes and capabilities
Define, prioritize, and maintain requirements as epics, user stories, and testable acceptance criteria, covering business rules, data, integrations, edge cases, and non-functional needs
Set up and run agile delivery, adapting Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid approaches to the product, and refine the backlog, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives
Plan and track scope, schedule, budget, resources, and dependencies, and keep delivery transparent through regular reporting and clear status updates
Identify and manage risks, issues, and dependencies early, and escalate decisions beyond the product's scope in a timely way
Act as a main point of contact for client and internal stakeholders, facilitate workshops, steering meetings, and reviews, and build agreement across teams
Coordinate cross-functional, often distributed teams, including vendors and partners, creating a collaborative and accountable working environment
Identify where AI can support business processes, and manage AI and data initiatives from discovery and proof of concept through production adoption, working with AI specialists on feasibility, data readiness, evaluation, and responsible use
Use AI tools responsibly to support analysis and product work, such as summarizing input, drafting requirements, planning, and reporting, while following client and company data-handling rules

Requirements
Proven experience in business analysis and/or product management on IT, digital, or technology products, preferably in a client-facing or consulting environment
Strong skills in requirements elicitation, documentation, and prioritization, including user stories, acceptance criteria, and process modeling (for example BPMN or UML), and strong skills in planning, scope management, budget and resource tracking, and risk and issue management
Solid practical experience with agile methods and frameworks such as Scrum, Kanban, or SAFe, and the ability to combine them with traditional planning where needed
Understanding of the software development lifecycle, data, and system integrations, with enough technical literacy to discuss solutions and trade-offs with architects and engineers
Working understanding of AI and generative AI use cases, limitations, and delivery considerations, such as data quality, evaluation, privacy, and human oversight
Practical experience using AI tools to support everyday work, with good judgment on when and how to use them
Strong facilitation and stakeholder management skills, including running workshops, managing expectations, handling conflicting priorities, and communicating clearly with business and technical audiences
Ability to structure ambiguous problems, lead teams, and build alignment without formal authority, including in distributed and multicultural settings
Experience with collaboration and delivery tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Miro, or similar
Strong written and spoken communication skills in English

Nice to have
Experience in the automotive industry or similarly complex manufacturing or engineering environments
Experience delivering AI, data, or cloud transformation products
Business analysis, agile, or product management certifications, such as CBAP, CCBA, PSPO, PSM, PMP, PRINCE2, or SAFe; equivalent applied experience is equally valuable
Experience with the commercial side of delivery, such as fixed-price or time-and-materials engagements, estimation, and contract management
Experience with data analysis, SQL, or reporting tools such as Power BI

Join us as we accelerate the transformation!
Join our team
Join Epiroc’s central Group M&A (Mergers & Acquisitions) team in Stockholm and play a pivotal role in shaping our global growth. Reporting to the Head of Group M&A, you will collaborate with leaders across all divisions to set acquisition priorities, identify attractive businesses and turn strategic opportunities into completed transactions. This is a high-impact role with global reach, strong collaboration across the organization and genuine deal ownership.
 
Job description: 
  Your mission
 You will manage international acquisitions from opportunity assessment to signing and closing, while helping our divisions define where and how to grow through M&A. Combining strategic insight with hands-on execution, you will take ownership of complex processes, make sound commercial judgments and keep deals moving.
  Partner with stakeholders across Epiroc’s divisions to shape global M&A strategies, map attractive markets, originate opportunities and develop prioritized target pipelines.
 Take ownership of multiple transactions end to end: target approach, initial assessment, investment thesis, offers, due diligence, negotiation, signing and closing.
 Develop and evaluate detailed financial models, DCF and comparable valuations, investment cases, synergy assessments, scenarios and returns analyses; translate insights into clear recommendations.
 Coordinate cross-functional due diligence across finance, tax, legal, commercial, operational and other workstreams; direct external advisors and convert findings into practical deal decisions and protections.
 Drive negotiations on valuation, deal structure, purchase price mechanisms, working capital and net debt, and key commercial SPA terms in partnership with legal counsel.
 Present investment recommendations to senior stakeholders; coordinate governance, regulatory approvals and closing readiness, and ensure a strong transition into integration planning.
 Profile description:
Your profile
 You are an accomplished M&A professional who pairs rigorous financial analysis with sharp commercial judgment and effective execution. Comfortable with senior executives, sellers and advisors worldwide, you build trust, question assumptions constructively and take ownership without waiting for direction. You bring energy, resilience and commitment to complex transactions, create momentum when obstacles arise and go the extra mile at critical moments. You value teamwork, hold yourself to high standards and take pride in seeing deals through to completion.
 This position requires deep, practical M&A expertise and a sustained track record of transaction execution.
  At least 7 years of dedicated, hands-on M&A experience, ideally in investment banking, private equity, transaction advisory or an established corporate M&A team. A university degree in finance, economics or a closely related field is strongly preferred.
 A strong track record of personally driving multiple M&A transactions across key stages, including due diligence, negotiation, signing and closing. You must be ready to take ownership of a transaction process with limited supervision.
 Advanced practical skills in financial modelling and valuation (DCF, comparables, transaction returns, net debt and working capital), together with a solid understanding of deal structures, SPA economics and execution risks.
 Experience in cross-border transactions and complex stakeholder environments is highly valued. Industrial or mining-sector knowledge is an advantage, but not essential.
 Fluent English and excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to deliver clear, persuasive recommendations to senior stakeholders.

 Based in Stockholm, Sweden, with a global remit across Epiroc’s divisions and markets. The position reports to the Global Head of M&A. International travel is required according to transaction activity.

Unit for Field-based Forest Research
Would you like to take on a key leadership role, guiding a dedicated team and contributing to the future of field-based forest research? With us, you will have the opportunity to work outdoors in spectacular natural surroundings and help develop groundbreaking projects addressing forest ecosystem and climate-related issues.
We are looking for a hands-on professional with research experience and leadership skills to lead operations at the Siljansfors and Jädraås Experimental Forests, as well as serve as a member of the management team for the entire Unit for Field-Based Forest Research. This position offers excellent opportunities for someone who enjoys a varied range of responsibilities, thrives on challenges, and wants to contribute to research on boreal forest production and forest ecosystems.
In 2024, the Unit revised its strategic operational plan through to 2030, resulting in a partially new organisation structure that has recently been implemented. In line with the Faculty’s ambition to broaden its activities, the Unit’s remit is also being gradually expanded. This calls for a cohesive and functional organisation across the Unit, structured around its four main areas of activity: long-term experiments, major research infrastructure, commissioned projects, and environmental monitoring and analysis.
About the position
You will be a member of the Unit’s management team. As manager of the Siljansfors and Jädraås Experimental Forests, you will have overall responsibility for operations within your area of responsibility (Svealand and southern Norrland), including financial and personnel management, as well as occupational health and safety matters. Your role is to ensure that activities at the experimental forests develop in a way that best supports field research, environmental monitoring, and education, while remaining within the allocated budget. Cooperation within SLU and engagement with the surrounding community are also ongoing aspects of the station managers responsibilities.
As the station manager, you will work together with your colleagues to ensure that ongoing forest field experiments are maintained and revised according to plan, using modern technology, and that new experiments are established today to address future research questions. You will be responsible for the content of metadata databases and the databases associated with them. You will also be responsible for ensuring that the Siljansfors team actively participates in the steering groups for the Unit’s various main areas of activity, and that the tasks agreed upon by these groups are implemented within your area of responsibility. An important part of the role involves receiving requests and, whenever possible, carrying them out. These may concern the establishment or revision of forest field experiments, environmental monitoring assignments, as well as teaching or outreach activities.
During the snow-free season, you will also participate in practical fieldwork, which involves spending considerable time outdoors and undertaking shorter periods of work-related travel. 
Your profile
Requirements:
Higher education in forestry, preferably supplemented by doctoral studies or other relevant experience in academic work, and a good understanding of the conditions and requirements of research
Extensive experience with practical fieldwork in forest environments
The ability to organise and structure work, and to act in an educational and diplomatic manner
A valid category B driver’s license
Good command of both Swedish and English

Desirable Qualifications:
Management experience, including personnel responsibility
Practical experience in forestry operations and forest inventory
Experience working with databases, GIS data, and related software
Familiar with methods and techniques for tree measurement and field data collection
Experience with meteorological instruments and data loggers

We place great importance on your personal qualities. Of particular importance is your ability to handle unexpected situations, for example when new tasks need to be undertaken at short notice. The position is based at the Siljansfors experimental forest office in central Mora, and at the field station in Siljansfors, 18 km southwest of Mora. SLU’s Faculty of Forest Sciences is located in Umeå.
Employment: Permanent, full-time position. SLU applies a probationary employment period.
About the employment: Your title will be Experiment Group Leader, with the additional responsibility of station manager. This responsibility will be transferred to you at a time agreed upon by you, the current station manager and the Unit Director.

jobs.description:
We’re one of the world’s oldest start-ups - and we’re just getting started. 
At Husqvarna Group, innovation is in our DNA. With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. From robotic lawn mowers to cutting-edge chainsaws and sustainable battery systems, we’re shaping the future -  and we want you to be part of it. 

About the Team
The Electromechanics Design Department within Global Robotics R&D Technology consists of 16 engineers specializing in verification, mechanics, mechatronics, and electronics. We are responsible for the electromechanical systems used in our robotic mower platforms and work across the complete product lifecycle, from technology investigations and feasibility studies to product development projects and maintenance activities.
Our team defines system requirements, drives technical coordination across disciplines, and leads verification and validation activities in close collaboration with software, electronics, sourcing, quality, and manufacturing teams.
We offer an international and collaborative working environment characterized by openness, professionalism, and a strong passion for technology and innovation.

About the role
We are looking for a Design Engineer with experience in electrical and/or electromechanical component development to strengthen our electromechanics team.
In this role, you will play a key part in the development of future robotic platforms and act as a technical contributor and coordinator in cross-functional projects. Depending on experience, the role may also include technical leadership responsibilities.
The primary focus of the role is the development and management of Power Supply Units (PSUs), including PSUs both with and without communication interfaces. Responsibility also includes other electrical components such as wiring harnesses, user interface hardware, connectors, and related electromechanical subsystems.
Development activities are carried out in close collaboration with both internal stakeholders and external development partners and suppliers.

Your responsibilities will include:
Development, specification, and integration of power supply units and other electrical components
Defining component requirements and securing technical compliance throughout the product lifecycle
Coordinating development activities in tight cooperation with suppliers and external engineering partners
Leading technical investigations, concept evaluations, and feasibility studies
Cross-functional coordination in tight cooperation with mechanics, electronics, sourcing, quality, manufacturing, and others
Planning and execution of verification and validation activities
Driving continuous improvements in development methodologies, processes, and engineering tools
Supporting technology roadmaps and future platform strategies within electrical systems and components

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent
About 3 years of relevant industrial experience
Experience in product development involving electrical or electromechanical systems
Experience working with suppliers and external development partners
Strong communication skills in Swedish and English, both written and spoken

Meritorious Experience
The following experience is considered highly valuable:
Development and specification of Power Supply Units (PSUs)
Electrical distribution systems, wiring harnesses, connectors, and related components
Low-voltage electrical systems and electronics integration
Product development within consumer products, robotics, automotive, or related industries
Verification and validation of electrical and electromechanical products, especially round component certification
Technical leadership or project coordination
Experience working with global suppliers and development partners
Experience with CATIA Electrical or other similar 3D tools
Experience with Teamcenter and product lifecycle management (PLM) systems

Personal Profile
We are looking for a curious and driven engineer with a genuine interest in technology and product development. You are proactive, structured, and comfortable taking ownership of technical challenges. You enjoy collaborating across disciplines, building strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders, and contributing to the development of both products and working methods.
You have a pragmatic mindset, can balance technical details with a system perspective, and are motivated by turning concepts into robust production-ready solutions.

Location
The assignment is based at Husqvarna Group's Robotics R&D center in Huskvarna, Sweden. A significant on-site presence is expected, as close collaboration with development teams, suppliers, prototypes, products, and test equipment is an essential part of the role.

jobs.description:
Department of Plant Breeding
We are seeking a highly motivated researcher with a strong background in genetics, genomics and crop improvement
About the position
The position focuses on understanding the genetic basis of disease resistance and grain nutrient quality in wheat and lentil, with particular emphasis on micronutrients such as iron and zinc. The overall objective is to identify genetic regions and markers associated with resistance, nutritional and quality traits which can contribute to future breeding efforts. The position will also contribute to the development of data-driven approaches for crop improvement and food innovation. The successful candidate will contribute to integrating advanced genomic and phenotypic approaches with metabolomic and ionomic analyses, food processing and emerging artificial intelligence approaches, within a research environment working at the interface of genetics and pre-breeding/crop improvement.
The candidate will lead experimental and analytical work within the subject and collaborate with other researchers and students in the group as well as outside the organisation.
The work will include:
Analyse Genotyping by sequencing (GBS) data (quality control, read mapping and SNP calling)
Genome-wide association studies (GWAS)
Field evaluation and phenotyping of diverse germplasm
Data analysis, interpretation, and preparation of scientific publications within the subject
Participate in collaborative research activities and supervision of students
Apply for external research funding

Your profile
Qualification requirements
The following qualifications are required:
A PhD in plant genetics, plant breeding, agriculture, or a related field
Good understanding of the genetic basis of complex quantitative traits
Experience with GBS data and GWAS
Experience with nutritional quality traits in crops
Experience with metabolomic and ionomic profiling including the integration and analysis of multi-omics datasets
Experience with advanced statistical methods for analysing genetic and phenotypic data
Practical experience with field experiments, data collection and phenotyping
Good skills in the programming language R or a comparable language
Very good written and oral English skills

The candidate must be able to take a leading role in research development as well as to collaborate in research groups and have good overall communication skills.
Additional qualifications
The following qualifications are meritorious:
Experience in plant pathology and/or plant physiology
Machine learning, artificial intelligence or other data-driven approaches to biological datasets

Assessment criteria
Assessment will be based on the applicant’s scientific competence and experience relevant to the research area of the position. Emphasis will be placed on documented experience in field phenotyping and analysis of genetic data.
The evaluation will also consider the applicant’s ability to conduct independent research, collaborate within a multidisciplinary research environment, and communicate scientific results through publications and presentations.

The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping. 
As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too. 

About the job 
Ready to take on challenging mechanical engineering work with a clear purpose? 
With us you will contribute to global priorities such as energy efficiency, clean water, and Alfa Laval's net-zero 2030 ambition. Let's shape a better tomorrow together! 
 
We design and supply process solutions within various industries, mainly water treatment. 
As a Mechanical Engineer and FEM/FEA specialist, you will design solutions in 3D with detailed engineering combined with standard components. Our designs contain pipes, pumps, decanters, evaporators, membranes, heat exchangers etc. 
 
Your work involves verification and optimization of mechanical and process equipment, by identifying critical stress concentrations, deformations, and failure modes etc. In this role, you will perform simulations as well as traditional hand calculations to ensure our products meet functional, safety, and regulatory requirements. 
During project execution you will be working in global project teams with Project Managers, Process Specialists, Automation, Sourcing, and Workshops. 
 
Key tasks and responsibilities:

Job Description
Are you passionate about the evolving creator economy and how creators can drive both brand relevance and commercial impact? We’re looking for a Creator Marketing Lead - Affiliate & Creator Commerce to shape and build how we work with creator-led commerce at scale. 
In this role, you’ll lead the strategic direction of our creator affiliate offering and turn that strategy into scalable capabilities, ways of working and measurable business results. You’ll work closely with Creator Marketing, Affiliate, Media and local market teams to build a connected creator ecosystem and unlock the full potential of our creator partnerships across the business. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO 
As Creator Marketing Lead - Affiliate & Creator Commerce, you’ll shape the strategy and build the capabilities required to grow creator commerce across markets. You’ll translate strategic priorities into clear plans, processes, tools and technology, while driving collaboration across teams and markets. 
You will: 
Define and drive the creator affiliate and commerce strategy, ensuring it complements the broader affiliate strategy and overall creator marketing direction. 
Build scalable operating models, processes, tools and technology that enable creator commerce across markets. 
Shape quarterly strategies, priorities and budget allocation within your area. 
Work closely with markets to identify commercial opportunities and define activation plans. 
Lead and guide Creator Marketing Specialists and Coordinators in campaign execution and delivery. 
Oversee campaign execution, budget management, performance and stakeholder alignment. 
Identify opportunities to maximise creator value across awareness, engagement and conversion. 
Build strong collaboration across Creator Marketing, Affiliate, Media and local market teams, ensuring partnerships and creator relationships are leveraged strategically across initiatives. 
Balance performance and commercial objectives with long-term creator relationships and strong brand alignment. 
Use performance insights and learnings to continuously evolve the creator commerce offering and identify new opportunities for growth. 

WHO YOU ARE 
We’re looking for a strategic and commercially minded creator marketing professional who combines deep expertise with a builder mentality. You’re comfortable setting direction, but equally motivated by turning strategy into something tangible, scalable and actionable. 
You understand both the relationship-driven side of creator marketing and the performance-driven nature of affiliate and creator commerce. You can navigate a complex stakeholder landscape, influence across teams and markets and turn business needs into clear operational and technical requirements. 
We are looking for people with: 
Extensive experience within creator, influencer or affiliate marketing, with strong expertise in creator commerce and performance-driven partnerships. 
Proven experience building or scaling creator-led commercial or affiliate programmes. 
Strong strategic planning and prioritisation skills, with the ability to translate strategy into execution. 
A solid understanding of affiliate platforms, tracking, attribution, tools and technology supporting creator commerce. 
A commercial mindset with a strong focus on measurable results, business impact and optimisation. 
Experience managing budgets, priorities and performance across multiple initiatives or markets. 
Excellent stakeholder management skills and confidence working across senior, cross-functional and international teams. 
Experience leading, coaching or guiding specialists and coordinators in campaign delivery. 
The ability to balance short-term commercial opportunities with long-term creator relationships and brand priorities. 
A collaborative, curious and proactive approach, with the drive to build new capabilities and ways of working.

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.  
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 
 

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE  
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits and extensive development opportunities across the globe. You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where your ideas matter. 
 
 
JOIN US  
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things - our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.  
This is a full-time permanent position based in Stockholm. Please apply as soon as possible by submitting your CV in English. Due to data privacy regulations, we only accept applications through our career page.  
We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

We offer
You will become part of a global Mechanical Engineering Management Team supporting the Pulp, Energy and Circularity business area. Want to know more?

Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
We are currently recruiting two radiographers for a smaller, well-functioning radiology department in coastal central Sweden.
This is a long-term opportunity for someone who values modern equipment, close teamwork and a healthy work-life balance, with daytime working hours and no evenings, nights, weekends or public holidays.
The department
The department is a smaller radiology unit with approximately 10 employees, providing both planned and acute diagnostic imaging in close collaboration with inpatient care and primary care.
The facilities have recently been modernised and the department works with new technology, including:
Canon CT
Samsung conventional X-ray
Ultrasound

The team consists of radiographers, assistant nurses, a radiologist and a sonographer.
There is also close collaboration with a larger radiology department, providing the opportunity to occasionally gain experience in a setting with a higher acute patient flow.
The role
The position includes standard duties as a radiographer, primarily within:
CT
Conventional radiography
Planned and acute examinations

You will work closely with radiographers, radiologists, assistant nurses and other healthcare professionals.
Working hours are Monday to Friday, 07:30–16:00. There are no evening or night shifts, no weekend work, no work on public holidays and no on-call duties.
Previous experience as a radiographer is an advantage but not a requirement. Experience with CT and conventional radiography is considered particularly valuable.
 
 
The location
The hospital is located in a smaller coastal community in central Sweden, with approximately 24,000 inhabitants in the local area.
The area combines small-town living with close access to the sea, lakes, countryside and an extensive archipelago. It is particularly well suited to those looking for a quieter lifestyle with good opportunities for outdoor activities and family life.
The area offers access to schools and childcare, as well as good transport connections to larger cities.
Requirements
We are looking for a candidate who:
Holds an EU-recognised qualification as a Radiographer
The profession must be regulated in the country of qualification
Currently working in an active clinical role as a radiographer
Full legal right to practise independently as a radiographer
Is interested in working with CT and conventional radiography
Enjoys working as part of a team and has as a professional and patient-centred approach
Has good communication skills in English
Is motivated to learn Swedish and adapt to the Swedish healthcare system
Is interested in establishing a long-term career and life in Sweden

 
Language and relocation
Swedish language training starts in your home country through individual online lessons with a private teacher. You study several hours per week alongside your current work.
Relocation to Sweden takes place once you have reached Swedish level B2.
After moving to Sweden, you begin working at 50% in a Radiography Assistant role while continuing your Swedish studies from B2 to C1.
Work and language training are combined during this period, with work in the mornings and Swedish studies in the afternoons, Monday to Friday.
The language education is provided and financed as part of the recruitment process.
You begin working fully as a radiographer once the required Swedish language level has been reached and Swedish professional authorization has been obtained.
Salary
During the language completion phase while employed as a Radiography Assistant, the salary is:

jobs.occupation: Permanent nursing positions in Jondal, Norway
jobs.description:
On behalf of Ullensvang Municipality, we are recruiting nurses for permanent positions in municipal healthcare services in Jondal, Western Norway.
You will work across both nursing home and home care services, giving you the opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills. You will follow patients over time, make independent clinical assessments and work closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.
Jondal is a small community in the Hardanger region on Norway’s west coast, around 1 hour and 45 minutes from Bergen by car and ferry. Here, you will live by the Hardangerfjord, surrounded by mountains, with Folgefonna, one of Norway’s largest glaciers, just 19 kilometres away.
Moving to another country is a big step, and we will support you throughout the process. Dignus Medical provides free Norwegian language training, assistance with Norwegian authorisation and practical support with relocation and settling into your new community.
About the position
As a nurse in Jondal, you will work with patients with different healthcare and care needs, both in a nursing home and in their own homes.
The role gives you a high degree of professional responsibility and the opportunity to follow patients over time, while working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.
Your responsibilities will include:
Providing nursing care and following up patients
Clinical observation, assessment and documentation
Medication management and treatment
Providing care to patients in nursing homes and in their own homes
Making independent clinical assessments
Working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals
Communicating with relatives and other parts of the healthcare service

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for qualified nurses who are confident in their professional role, comfortable working independently and motivated to build a new life and career in Norway.
You:
Hold a valid nursing licence from an EU/EEA country
Hold citizenship from an EU/EEA country
Speak English fluently and are highly motivated to learn Norwegian
Are willing to complete our free Norwegian language programme before starting work
Hold a valid driving licence
Work well both independently and as part of a team
Preferably have experience from community healthcare, nursing homes or home care services

We help you prepare for working in Norway
You do not need to speak Norwegian when you apply. If you are selected for the position, Dignus Medical will guide you through the entire process of preparing for your move to Norway.
We provide:
Free online Norwegian language training with a private teacher
Language training up to the required B2 level, including Norwegian for healthcare professionals
Assistance with your application for Norwegian nursing authorisation
Guidance with the documentation and administrative processes required before starting work
Help with finding accommodation and practical aspects of relocating to Norway
Personal follow-up before, during and after your move

The language training and authorisation process take place before you start working, so you have time to prepare both professionally and practically for your new life in Norway.
What you can expect in Jondal
A permanent position in the Norwegian municipal healthcare system
Varied work across nursing home and home care services
The opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills
Independent professional responsibility
Close cooperation with colleagues and other healthcare professionals
The opportunity to follow patients over time
Support with housing, relocation and practical arrangements

Life between the fjord, mountains and glacier
Jondal is located in Hardanger on Norway’s west coast, around 1 hour and 45 minutes from Bergen by car and ferry. It is a small community of around 400 people, situated directly by the Hardangerfjord and surrounded by mountains. Folgefonna, one of Norway’s largest glaciers, is only 19 kilometres away.
Nature is part of everyday life here. After work, you can hike in the mountains, kayak or fish on the fjord, or simply enjoy the quiet surroundings. In winter, the area offers excellent opportunities for skiing and other outdoor activities.
Despite its small size, Jondal has the essentials you need for everyday life, including a grocery store, places to eat and local cultural and leisure activities. If you are moving with your family, Jondal has both a kindergarten and a school for children from primary through lower secondary level, as well as a library, swimming pool and sports facilities. Odda is around 40 minutes away by car, while Bergen offers a larger city environment and an international airport.
Interested in starting a new chapter in Norway?
Feel free to get in touch for further information, or send us your application.

Lean and Agile ways of working
